title: Symplectic Heisenberg Group over a Finite Field
body_html:
Symplectic Heisenberg Group over a Finite Field

Let $k$ be a finite field of odd order, let $(E,j)$ be a finite-dimensional symplectic $k$-vector space, and put $i=j/2$. The Heisenberg group $H(E,j)$ is the set $E \times k$ with group law

$$ (w,z)(w',z')=(w+w',z+z'+i(w,w')). $$

It is a central extension

$$ 0 \to k \to H(E,j) \to E \to 0. $$
